decisions.reason: The construction site dumper fits the firm's announced direction in construction and transport vehicles and draws on the vehicle engineering invested in the dropped mining machines, so management is inclined to persist and blame weak results on temporary market conditions, even though it was only mentioned on the website rather than given its own page.
The inclined furniture lift got its own page, which signals visible commitment to a lifting line that fits the firm's lifting focus, so management will keep it despite the lack of recent evidence.
The building material lift shares design and investment with the furniture lift family and was publicly presented on its own page, which encourages persistence.

The truck-mounted variant extends the committed lift family, and its sunk development costs and visible presentation favor keeping it, though its higher cost and narrower niche add some risk of being dropped.
